scenarios.name: revocation
scenarios.authorized_path: wa_context_issuer restricted own-grant UPDATE revokedAt only; no source-generation or business write

scenarios.name: security_generation
scenarios.authorized_path: Registered Identity owner security-generation transition on UserSecurityProfile.securityGeneration with its own grant, CAS and required evidence; issuer does not edit Identity rows

scenarios.name: source_generation
scenarios.authorized_path: Registered Customer owner mutation with its own grant, CAS and atomic source/history/evidence/intents. This fixture binds sourceGeneration to CustomerProfile.revision; it is not a universal mapping for other owners

setup.fixture_gate: Generation-change paths need the approved owner-specific P0-C fixture operation. If absent, keep NOT_RUN; never grant broad issuer/runtime updates merely to prepare this test

P0C-CTX-02.action: For each actual subject login on A, execute the common sequence, then exactly one separate named scenario. R or G must commit its authorized change before A issues its next protected statement. A uses its original now-stale grant and must be denied, without a forbidden source mutation or protected disclosure. Rollback A after observation; do not roll back or mislabel the legitimate separate owner change. Revocation, Identity security-generation change and Customer source-generation change are distinct runs.
P0C-CTX-02.expected: Every named committed revocation/generation change is seen by A currentness checks; the stale protected action has no unauthorized mutation/effect/disclosure. All cases remain NOT_RUN until separately authorized execution.

lease.name: lease-revoke-lease
lease.transaction_contract: Root opens actual app READ COMMITTED transaction, captures login/pid/xid before business locks, issuer independently commits fresh handle hash + exact finite caps, then app binds handle. SQL contains neither handle nor issuer writes. Failure requires client/backend closure before independent observer; never treat command count as a commit proof.
lease.diagnostic_limit: For P0002 require source-bound customer_atomic frame; state alone does not identify missing history/evidence. Unlisted diagnostics stop. 23505 proves native duplicate rejection only, not a production semantic-idempotency adapter.
